headline: Review of RLF administrative plan, next year's loan fund projections, and portfolio updates including California Burritos and BDC Capital.
summary: The committee will review the 2025-2026 RLF plan and next year's projections, discuss an update to the RLF Administrative Plan, and go over portfolio updates on California Burritos, delinquent client requests, and a new deal participation opportunity with BDC Capital.
items: RLF 2025-2026 Plan Review and Next year projections (10 min)
RLF Portfolio Updates: Responses to Delinquent client requests
RLF Portfolio Updates: BDC Capital with a new deal participation opportunity
plain_text:
Greater Nashua Revolving Loan Fund (RLF) Committee 
The Greater Nashua Revolving Loan Fund’s mission is to provide flexible, impact-
focused capital through responsible lending practices to small businesses in 
Greater Nashua. Our vision is to preserve and grow jobs and generate economic 
opportunities for all residents in the community. 
 
Meeting Agenda 
Date: October 19, 2026; Time: 12:00 p.m. to 01:00 p.m.  Location: Room 208, 2nd Floor Meeting  
1. Welcome and Introductions 
2. Approval of Minutes Review and approval of the September 21, 2026 meeting minutes. 
3. RLF 2025-2026 Plan Review and Next year projections (10 min) 
4. RLF Administrative Plan Update (30 min) 
5. RLF Portfolio Updates:  
o California Burritos 
o Responses to Delinquent client requests 
o BDC Capital with a new deal participation opportunity  
6. Others Business 
7. Next Meeting November 16, 2026 | 12:00–1:00 PM
